text:
alex: Quick postmortem follow-up: I pulled the action items from yesterday's kv-cache OOM postmortem and grouped them by experiment/infra/ops. Sharing owners + rough ETA. Please react with :thumbsup: if you own or say who should own.
maria: thanks — can you include the profiling command and where to drop traces?
alex: yes — added below. main priorities: 1) get deterministic repro on staging, 2) run per-shard residency experiments, 3) tune slab GC and soft limits, 4) add growth-rate-based throttles.
sophie: for repro — I can take the staging capture. plan: enable heap-trace for 4 hours during peak, then run kv-snapshot.
chris: owning slab GC tuning. will start with increasing fragmentation threshold from 0.35 -> 0.5 on canary pool. 2-day run, then revert if regressions.
jamal: ops will add an alert for sustained delta-residency > 20% over 10m and call paging policy. I'll also add a synthetic load to exercise evictions overnight.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary change (frag-threshold) -> hosts: pool-canary-2 -> ETA 2026-03-30 03:00 UTC.
alex: profiling command (staging):
```bash
export TRACE_DIR=/var/tmp/kv-traces
./run_profile --pool=staging-kv --duration=14400 --alloc-sample=1% --output=$TRACE_DIR/trace-$(date +%s).tar.gz
```
maria: where to upload traces?
alex: drop to s3://redwood-inference-dev/kv-traces/staging/ and tag with thread_ts-2376543210. I put a short script in the infra repo: infra/tools/kv-upload.sh
sophie: repro notes: the leak reproduces when client qps > 15k and key-hotness skew > 0.8. I'm adding a small harness to bump both.
chris: tuning plan details:
- step1: canary frag_threshold=0.5 (48h)
- step2: enable eager-evict for oversized segments (>128MB) on canary (72h)
- step3: roll to 20% non-prod fleet if stable
If any OOM or latency spike > 2x baseline, we revert.
jamal: ops tasks:
- add alert: residency-delta >20% for 10m -> P1 oncall page
- add throttle: growth-rate threshold 15% per 5m -> reject non-critical loads
- schedule nightly synthetic eviction test at 02:30 UTC
alex: ownership summary (please confirm):
- repro & traces: sophie (ETA 2d)
- profiling & trace upload script: maria (ETA 1d)
- slab GC tuning & canary: chris (ETA start 2026-03-30)
- alerts & throttles: jamal/ops (ETA 2026-03-31)
- retro writeup w/ metrics: alex (ETA 2026-04-02)
maria: confirmed on trace upload. I'll also add a small postmortem section with the trace pointer.
sophie: I'll run the harness tonight and push a gist with steps.
chris: starting canary tomorrow morning, will ping when changes hit canary.
jamal: ops-bot will create the alert tickets and link them here.
deploy-bot: ticket created: ALERT-4829 residency-delta >20% (assignee: jamal)
alex: quick Q — should we add a temporary global soft limit per-tenant while we iterate? reduces blast radius but may affect customers.
maria: yes agree for 48h while we experiment. ops, can you add 0.9x multiplier for tenants above 95th percentile for daily usage?
jamal: we can add tenant soft-multiplier rule. I'll draft RFC and a rollout plan for 48h guardrail. ETA 6h for proto.
chris: note: eager-evict may increase p99 latency on reads for hot keys. Will monitor and provide dashboards.
sophie: logging snippet from staging run that looked suspicious: 
"[2026-03-28T01:12:45Z] shard=17 residency=0.78 alloc_delta=+45MB/s frag=0.41 gc_runs=3"
alex: perfect. next steps: owners confirm, ops add alerts + tenant guardrail, sophie+maria produce repro+traces. we'll regroup in 48h with metrics. thanks all :rocket:
